study_object: Harness methodology enabling autonomous research with existing frontier models; fixed base-model weights.

source.title: SKILLFOUNDRY: Building Self-Evolving Agent Skill Libraries from Heterogeneous Scientific Resources

verdict: Scientific executable skill acquisition, validation, refinement and downstream utility directly collide. The retained v1 does not directly test own prior research experience transferred to held-out new datasets with fully amortized cost break-even. This does not establish global novelty.

already_studied.claim: Mine scientific resources into operational contracts and executable skill packages.
Validate, repair, optimize against skill-versus-no-skill cases, merge and prune skills.
Evaluate an existing skill library on six scientific benchmark datasets.
Construct task-specific scientific skills after receiving the target task prompt.

residual_question: Does learning executable procedures from the same researcher's own earlier task trajectories improve previously unseen datasets beyond strong fixed procedures and raw-note retrieval after charging acquisition and maintenance costs?

residual_evidence.claim: Related work explicitly distinguishes mining heterogeneous scientific resources from construction primarily from trajectories, failures, reinforcement learning or manual engineering.
No explicit source-own-research to held-out-target-dataset acquisition/evaluation split is reported for the six-dataset MoSciBench skill-versus-no-skill evaluation.
residual_evidence.caution: Absence of a reported exclusion protocol is not evidence that leakage occurred.

residual_evidence.claim: For cell annotation, the framework receives the target prompt before retrieving resources, constructing candidate skills and testing them for the task.

residual_evidence.premise: The paper's scDRS transfer experiment is transfer from prior own research to a novel dataset/task.
residual_evidence.claim: Transfer means exporting task-specific skills to another agent, Biomni; evaluation is TMS FACS plus height GWAS with three replicates per setting.
The main study does not compare identical own-research records as raw-note retrieval versus learned procedures atop the same strong frozen executable base.
Pipeline cost is runtime under a fixed resource-mining budget rather than API token usage; no acquisition-to-target break-even curve is reported.

annotation_accuracy.baseline_comparability_note: SpatialAgent uses external reference data and different specialized tools.

novel_skill_percentage.meaning: No matching task skill found in external skill-library search; not new scientific discoveries or held-out task success.

design_consequences: Do not claim the first scientific skill library or first validation-and-refinement loop.
Use three primary arms: strong fixed researcher, same researcher plus own raw research notes, same researcher plus procedures learned from those exact records.
Freeze source experience before target exposure and split by original dataset family.
Let saved acquisition budget benefit the frozen baseline in the lifecycle-budget comparison.
Make compression and graph organization optional follow-ups after primary learned-procedure utility exists.
Measure numerical quality together with reproducible and complete outputs.
Limit success claims to the evaluated ML task distribution.
unresolved_novelty: cross-task all-in-cost studies outside these two retained sources
